{{Wireless adapter |brand=Fi Win |model=WM68 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=06/14/2004 |manuf_country=Taiwan |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=Mini PCI |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=Q5SWM68-1 |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Intersil |chip1_model=ISL3880 |chip2_brand=Intersil |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:0C:20 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "Fiwin" and "WM680-110" (??) is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
The FCC manual indicates the device is using the '''Frisbee''' chipset (ISL3880 + ISLxxxx).
The device is assumed to have a 00:0C:20 OUI. It's on a MAC label affixed to the FCC EUT (00:0C:20:00:7B:5F, BTW) and it is also in the FCC manual..
